newsitem.title: USA: Dun & Bradstreet declares special dividend.
newsitem.headline: Dun & Bradstreet declares special dividend.

text.p: Dun & Bradstreet Corp said on Thursday that it declared a special dividend to shareholders, as the final step in its strategic restructuring into three independent, publicly-traded companies.
Shareholders would receive one share of Cognizant Corp common stock for each Dun & Bradstreet common stock and one AC Nielsen common stock for each three Dun & Bradstreet shares.

Cognizant supplies information solutions to the pharmaceutical and healthcare industries and AC Nielsen supplies market research, information and analysis to the consumer products and services industries.
The dividend was payable to shareholders of record at the close of business on October 21, the company said.

Cognizant and AC Nielsen stock certificates would be distributed on or about November 1. The company said shareholders should retain their Dun & Bradstreet stock certificates, which represented shares of the "new" Dun & Bradstreet.

The "new" entity would consist of Dun & Bradstreet information Services, Moody's Investor Service and Rueben H. Donnelley, the largest independent marketer of Yellow Pages advertising in the United States.
